1.why: Set pairs a concession (Nevertheless) against restatement/time/result; contrast is the likeliest intended pivot in a 4-way transition set.

2.why: Derivational hub: A shares its exact 1.5x ratio with C and its 0.22 delta with B, so A is the value the distractors were built from.

3.why: Nevertheless is the only true concessive against Meanwhile/In short/Instead, and concession is the standard key shape here.

4.why: Chose the non-obvious causal predictor (enclosure temperature swings) over the intuitive ones (mechanism age, custodian resetting) that read as distractors.

5.why: Consequently is the only result connective; Meanwhile/To be sure/In addition are the usual foils.

6.why: Perfect arithmetic ladder (36/27, 34/25, 31/22, 28/19 with a constant 5-point rescan gap) so I took a non-endpoint middle value.

7.why: Therefore is the lone consequence marker among addition/contrast/example.

8.why: For example is the only exemplification option and the set otherwise offers time/result/contrast, one of each.

9.why: Still is the only concessive among example/time/substitution.

10.why: 'held steady near 40 percent' gives the cleanest treated-vs-control contrast for a 'main finding'; the rising-control versions overstate.

11.why: In other words is the only restatement marker; the other three are all pivots of some kind and cancel each other out.

12.why: Only B pairs an explicitly unrepresentative sample ('the market's busiest period') with a measurement gap ('whether a passerby actually bought anything').

13.why: Largest predicted-vs-measured gap (26% vs 9%) and the only explanation that is a property of the dust rather than a removal mechanism.

14.why: Smallest-but-plausible n with the classic uncontrolled confound (raised beds on a sunnier south wall), the standard cautious-summary shape.

15.why: By comparison is the only comparative; In that case and Regardless read as throwaway foils.

16.why: However is the only contrast against addition/result/specification.

17.why: As a result is the only causal option; Beforehand and Granted are weak foils.

18.why: Even so is the only concessive among result/specification/addition.

19.why: Weak foil set (Even then, Regardless, If so); In practice is the only one that marks a real theory-vs-reality shift.

20.why: As a consequence is the only result connective; In the meantime is a near-pure filler distractor.

21.why: By contrast is the only comparative-contrast marker; Nevertheless is concessive, not comparative, and If so is a foil.

22.why: By contrast is the only comparison among addition/substitution/conditional-negative.

23.why: Specifically is the only narrowing marker; Likewise/Admittedly/For this reason each cover a different unrelated relation.

24.why: However is the only contrast against example/emphasis/similarity.
